author: Gert Marginet
name: CAT event
description: An in-process event with its subscriber and its test. The core project needs the package gmarginet.Cat.EventAggregators.Abstractions, and the test project gmarginet.Cat.UnitTesting.EventAggregators. Run it in the folder of the solution of a service.

ServiceName.description: The full name of the service, such as Contoso.Shop.Orders.

Tests.description: Add the test. Use false for a service without the project ServiceName.CoreService.Tests.
